properties.comment: DML statements for the Django-backed role service (reads geoserver_auth.roles / geoserver_auth.user_roles). Every query keeps the exact number of "?" placeholders that org.geoserver.security.jdbc.JDBCRoleService binds for that key (verified against its source), even for queries that are structurally no-ops (role/user "properties" and group support aren't modeled in Django) -- otherwise JDBCRoleService's ps.setString(n, ...) throws "column index out of range" the moment any page touches that query, which is how this exact file was debugged into existence. Don't drop a "?" to "simplify" a no-op query.
